notes: «حدثنا أبي» : the father is named only by relation, so the first link is a relation; the editor gloss «- رحمه الله -» is left out
«يرفعه إلى» is a gap, an unnamed link in its place; the Imam after it is inside the chain, so he stays a narrator
needs ruling: «قال: قلت: قبل نظره إلى أهل الموقف؟ قال: نعم» is a first-person questioner («قلت») who is not named; whether he is a further link is not settled by the text
